## B. Diesel Rate

In case theprice of diesel became greater /less thanEGP 15.50 as a Base Rate per liter, the following formula shall be applied only when a new governmental decreeisissuedofficiallyenforcingthisincrease.

V2 (EGP) = V1 X (1 - Advance Payment Percentage) X 0.04 X [(Diesel new rate/ Diesel fixed rate) -1].

Where:

- V1(EGP) = the gross value for all the certified work done for this particular payment certificate - the gross value of the certified work done for all plain, reinforced concrete and rebar bill items for this particular payment certificate.
- V2(EGP) = the additional/deduction value due to the increase or decrease of the Diesel rates.
